examples.text: vivaṭṭakath'ādi

apica vaṭṭamūlaṃ avijjā, vivaṭṭamūlaṃ buddh'uppādo, iti vaṭṭamūlaṃ avijjaṃ vivaṭṭamūlañ'ca buddh'uppādaṃ dassetvā'pi, puna ekavāraṃ vaṭṭavivaṭṭavasena desanaṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhi.
mās'aḍḍhamāsesu paññāyamānesu utusaṃvaccharā paññāyiṃsu. ettāvatā kho, vāseṭṭha, ayaṃ loko puna vivaṭṭo hoti.

69503.commentary: (PMa) saññāvivaṭṭe ñāṇan'ti saññāya vivaṭṭanaṃ parāvaṭṭanaṃ parammukhabhāvo'ti saññāvivaṭṭo, yāya saññāya te te bhāvanādhamme adhipatiṃ karoti, tāya saññāya hetubhūtāya, karaṇabhūtāya vā tato tato kāmacchandādito vivaṭṭane ñāṇan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: saññāvivaṭṭo, cetovivaṭṭo, cittavivaṭṭo, ñāṇavivaṭṭo, vimokkhavivaṭṭo, saccavivaṭṭo. sañjānanto vivaṭṭatī'ti, saññāvivaṭṭo.

kathaṃ adhipatattā paññā saññāvivaṭṭe ñāṇaṃ? nekkhamm'ādhipatattā paññā kāmacchandato saññāya vivaṭṭatī'ti, adhipatattā paññā saññāvivaṭṭe ñāṇaṃ. abyāpād'ādhipatattā paññā byāpādato saññāya vivaṭṭatī'ti, adhipatattā paññā saññāvivaṭṭe ñāṇaṃ.

69507.commentary: (MNa) rāga-dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhi-avijjā-duccarita-chadanehi sattahi paṭicchanne kiles'andhakāraloke taṃ chadanaṃ vivaṭṭetvā samantato sañjātāloko hutvā ṭhito'ti vivaṭṭacchado.

examples.text: sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭṭacchado.
imehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato nāma agāramajjhe vasanto rājā hoti cakkavattī, pabbajanto loke vivaṭṭacchado sabbaññubuddho hoti

69508.commentary: (DNa) āvaṭṭantī'ti āvaṭṭantiyo patitaṭṭhānam'eva āgacchanti vivaṭṭantī'ti patitaṭṭhānato parabhāgaṃ vaṭṭamānā gacchanti. apica dve pāde pasāretvā sakiṃ purato sakiṃ pacchato sakiṃ vāmato sakiṃ dakkhiṇato saṃparivattamānā'pi, āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭantī'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: sant'ānanda, devatā ākāse pathavīsaññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti, atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antaradhāyissatī'ti.

satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesiṃ. satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ. saṃvaṭṭamāne sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, loke ābhassar'ūpago homi, vivaṭṭamāne loke suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjāmi.

69512.meaning1: experience of the happiness of the ending of cyclical existence; experience of the ease of Nibbāna

examples.text: so evam'āha, atītaṃ'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ jānāmi, saṃvaṭṭi vā loko vivaṭṭi vā'ti. anāgataṃ'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ jānāmi, saṃvaṭṭissati vā loko vivaṭṭissati vā'ti. sassato attā ca loko ca vañjho kūṭaṭṭho esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhito.

69517.meaning1: having supporting conditions for ending the cycle of existence
69517.meaning2: ?? supporting conditions for ending the round

69519.meaning2: having turned back, having diverted, having destroyed

examples.text: bhutvāna bheke khalamūsikāyo, kaṭasīsu khittāni ca koṇapāni, mahāvane suññavane vivaḍḍho, amaññi kotthu migarāj'āham'asmi.

69523.commentary: (KVa) sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake'ti evaṃ sikkhāpadānaṃ vivaṇṇake garahaṇe pācittiyaṃ hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, kiṃ pan'imehi khudd'ānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāva'd'eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī'ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyaṃ.

69526.commentary: (VINa) upasampannassa vinayaṃ vivaṇṇetī'ti upasampannassa santike tassa tasmiṃ vimatiṃ uppādetu'kāmo vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti nindati garahati.

examples.text: apariyāpuṭaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, adhāritaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, vinayo vā antaradhāyatu, ime vā bhikkhū apakataññuno hontū'ti upasampannassa vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

69527.meaning1: wanting to disparage; wishing to speak badly (about)
69527.commentary: (VVt) anāpattivisayaṃ dassetum'āha navivaṇṇetu'kāmassā'ti-ādi. navivaṇṇetu'kāmassa handa sutt'antaṃ pariyāpuṇa, pacchā'pi vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇissasi iti evaṃ vadantassa anāpattī'ti yojanā.

examples.text: anāpatti na vivaṇṇetu'kāmo, iṅgha tvaṃ sutt'ante vā gāthāyo vā abhidhammaṃ vā pariyāpuṇassu, pacchā vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇissasī'ti bhaṇati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

69528.meaning1: to dispraise; to disapprove; to disparage; to speak badly (of)

examples.text: so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati. sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivattacchado.

69533.meaning1: with back turned; with shoulders twisted

examples.text: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ godhikaṃ dūrato'va mañcake vivattakkhandhaṃ semānaṃ.

69534.meaning1: who rolls back the veil (of illusion) (in)

examples.text: so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati. sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivattacchado.

69535.grammar: aor of caus of vi √vatt, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
69535.commentary: (ANa) vivattayi saṃyojanan'ti dasavidham'pi saṃyojanaṃ samūlakaṃ ubbattetvā chaḍḍesi. (SNa) vivattayi saṃyojanan'ti dasavidham'pi saṃyojanaṃ parivattayi nimmūlakam'akāsi.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabb'āsavasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mān'ābhisamayā antam'akāsi dukkhassā'ti

69536.commentary: (SNa) vivadatī'ti aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ anattā asubhan'ti yathāsabhāvena vadantena saddhiṃ niccaṃ sukhaṃ attā subhan'ti vadanto vivadati.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, lokena vivadāmi, loko'va mayā vivadati. na, bhikkhave, dhammavādī kenaci lokasmiṃ vivadati.
evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati, na kenaci vivadati, yañ'ca loke vuttaṃ tena voharati, aparāmasan'ti.
aññam'aññaṃ bhaṇḍanānī'ti catunnaṃ parisānaṃ tappakkhikānañ'ca eso dhammo, n'eso dhammo'ti aññam'aññaṃ vivadanāni. bhaṇḍanañ'hi kalahassa pubbabhāgo.

69541.meaning1: should be disputed; should be quarrelled about
69541.meaning2: should be disputed; should be quarrelled about
69541.commentary: (DNa) na vivaditabban'ti atthe vā byañjane vā vivādo na kātabbo.

examples.text: yattha sabbeh'eva saṅgamma samāgamma atthena atthaṃ byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yatha'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.

69544.commentary: (DNa) tevijjāvivanan'ti pupphaphalehi aparibhogarukkhehi sañchannaṃ nirudakaṃ araññaṃ. yattha maggato ukkamitvā parivattitum'pi na sakkā honti, taṃ sandhāy'āha tevijjāvivanan'ti'pi vuccatī'ti. (SNa) vivane'ti araññaṭṭhāne, nirudake araññe caturassapokkharaṇi-ādīni kārayeti attho.

examples.text: tasmā idaṃ tevijjānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ tevijjā-iriṇan'ti'pi vuccati, tevijjāvivanan'ti'pi vuccati, tevijjābyasanan'ti'pi vuccatī'ti.
kāraye assame ramme, vāsay'ettha bahussute, papañ'ca vivane kayirā, dugge saṅkamanāni ca.
yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ, aghaṃ aghagataṃ, vivaraṃ vivaragataṃ, asamphuṭṭhaṃ maṃsalohitehi upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu.

tattha n'atthi hantā vā ghātetā vā sotā vā sāvetā vā viññātā vā viññāpetā vā. yo'pi tiṇhena satthena sīsaṃ chindati, na koci kañci jīvitā voropeti. sattannaṃtv'eva kāyānam'antarena satthaṃ vivaram'anupatati.
na antalikkhe na samuddamajjhe, na pabbatānaṃ vivaraṃ pavissa, na vijjatī so jagatippadeso, yatthaṭṭhito mucceyya pāpakammā.
ye viruddhā sallapanti, viniviṭṭhā samussitā, anariyaguṇam'āsajja, añño'ñña-vivara-esino.
idha pan'āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti aparisuddhavacīsamācāro, labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ. evarūpe'pi, āvuso, puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo.
yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ, aghaṃ aghagataṃ, vivaraṃ vivaragataṃ, asamphuṭṭhaṃ maṃsalohitehi upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu y'āyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā… evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.

69551.commentary: (DNa) saṃvaraṇan'ti saṃvaraṇaṃ nāma ajja nakkhattaṃ sundaraṃ, ajj'eva samaggā hotha, iti vo viyogo na bhavissatī'ti evaṃ samaggakaraṇaṃ. vivaraṇaṃ nāma sace viyujjitu'kām'attha, ajj'eva viyujjatha, iti vo puna saṃyogo na bhavissatī'ti evaṃ visaṃyogakaraṇaṃ.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṃkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti.

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi tathārūpiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, atha kho naṃ khippam'eva satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu deseti vivarati uttānīkaroti, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nadī pabbateyyā dūraṅ'gamā sīghasotā hārahārinī. tassā puriso ubhato naṅgalamukhāni vivareyya.
na anāhaṭe kabaḷe mukhadvāraṃ vivarissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti… sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā… vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti
tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañ'c'eva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañ'ca uttānī karonti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.

69555.commentary: (VINa) ekacce vātapāne vivaranto'ti yesu vivaṭesu andhakāro hoti tāni vivaranto yesu vivaṭesu āloko hoti tāni thakento.

examples.text: sā'pi kho brāhmaṇī tassa brāhmaṇassa piṭṭhito pāvisi. atha kho āyasmā udāyī ekacce vātapāne vivaranto ekacce vātapāne thakento gabbhaṃ anuparigantvā piṭṭhito āgantvā tassā brāhmaṇiyā aṅgam'aṅgāni parāmasi.
iti cittakiriya-vāyodhātu-vipphāravasena heṭṭhimaṃ akkhidalaṃ adho sīdati, uparimaṃ uddhaṃ laṅgheti. koci yantakena vivaranto nāma n'atthi.

69556.meaning1: what is called an opening of mental clarity

69557.meaning1: falls through open space; drops through the gap
69557.commentary: (MNa) sattannaṃtv'eva kāyānan'ti yathā muggar'āsi'ādīsu pahaṭaṃ satthaṃ muggar'āsiādīnaṃ antarena pavisati, evaṃ sattannaṃ kāyānaṃ antarena chiddena vivarena satthaṃ pavisati. tattha ahaṃ imaṃ jīvitā voropemī'ti kevalaṃ saññāmattam'eva hotī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: tattha n'atthi hantā vā ghātetā vā sotā vā sāvetā vā viññātā vā viññāpetā vā. yo'pi tiṇhena satthena sīsaṃ chindati, na koci kañci jīvitā voropeti. sattannaṃtv'eva kāyānam'antarena satthaṃ vivaram'anupatati.

69558.meaning1: enters the space; goes into the gap

examples.text: yo'pi tiṇhena satthena sīsaṃ chindati, na so'pi kañci jīvitā voropeti, sattannaṃtv'eva kāyānam'antarena satthaṃ vivaram'anupavisati.

69560.grammar: abs of caus of vi √var, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
69560.meaning1: having uncovered; having unwrapped; having unveiled

examples.text: anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, sīsaṃ vivarāpetvā deseti, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro, tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno āḷindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi. vivari bhagavā dvāraṃ.
atha kho bhagavā kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi. vivariṃsu kho te bhikkhū bhagavato dvāraṃ.

tuyhaṃ kho pana, aggivessana, app'ekaccāni sedaphusitāni nalāṭā muttāni, uttar'āsaṅgaṃ vinibhinditvā bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhitāni. mayhaṃ kho pana, aggivessana, n'atthi eta'r'ahi kāyasmiṃ sedo'ti. iti bhagavā tasmiṃ parisati suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ kāyaṃ vivari.
atha kho bhagavā sundarikabhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa padasaddena sīsaṃ vivari. atha kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo muṇḍo ayaṃ bhavaṃ, muṇḍako ayaṃ bhavan'ti tato'va puna nivattitu'kāmo ahosi.
ta'y'idaṃ āyasmatā khemakena tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññāpitaṃ paṭṭhapitaṃ vivaritaṃ vibhajitaṃ uttānīkatan'ti.
na anāhaṭe kabaḷe mukhadvāraṃ vivaritabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca anāhaṭe kabaḷe mukhadvāraṃ vivarati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

69566.meaning1: should be revealed; should be exposed (to)

examples.text: evarūpaṃ te, rāhula, kāyakammaṃ satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu desetabbaṃ, vivaritabbaṃ, uttānīkātabbaṃ, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjitabbaṃ.

69567.meaning1: to clarify; to clear up; to elucidate

examples.text: sakkā evam'evaṃ viññāṇam'p'idaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ iti'p'idaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattā'ti.
na kho mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ vihes'āpekhā pucchimha, api c'āyasmā khemako pahosi tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ.

so'pi tesaṃ gatabhāvaṃ ñatvā vaccakuṭiyā padaraṃ vivaritvā oruyha ubhohi hatthehi ālopaṃ ālopaṃ katvā gūthaṃ khādi

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi tathārūpiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, atha kho naṃ khippam'eva satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu deseti vivarati uttānīkaroti, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.

69570.meaning1: being clarified; being cleared up; being elucidated (by)

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññapiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkariyamāne na jānāti na passati tam'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kin'ti karomi!

69571.commentary: (SNPa) ratyā vivasāne'ti rattisamatikkame, dutiyadivase'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (JAa) ratyā vivasāne'ti rattīnaṃ accayena, cirakāl'ātikkamenā'ti attho.
69571.notes: ABH suggests vi + √vas + āna or perhaps connected with sk uṣas 'dawn'

examples.text: tato ratyā vivasāne, sūriyass'uggamanaṃ pati, sabbaṃ taṇhaṃ visosetvā, pallaṅkena upāvisin'ti.
alaṃ, bhikkhave, mā bhaṇḍanaṃ mā kalahaṃ mā viggahaṃ mā vivādan'ti
kutopahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, kutopahūtā te tadiṅgha brūhi.

tassa parikkhāraṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, bhaṇḍanakārakaṃ kalahakārakaṃ vivādakārakaṃ bhassakārakaṃ saṅghe adhikaraṇakārakaṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, tassa parikkhāraṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā
vebhūtiyaṃ sahitabhedakāriṃ, bhedappavaḍḍhana-vivādakāriṃ, kalahappavaḍḍhanā-akiccakāriṃ, sahitānaṃ bhedajananiṃ na bhaṇi.
piyappahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, maccherayuttā kalahā vivādā, vivādajātesu ca pesuṇāni.
vissajja ganthāni mun'īdha loke, vivādajātesu na vaggasārī, santo asantesu upekkhako so, anuggaho uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

69577.grammar: masc, comp, loc pl of vivādajāta, loc abs
69577.meaning1: when quarrels have arisen; when arguments occur
69577.commentary: (NIDD1) vivādajātesu… vivāde jāte sañjāte nibbatte abhinibbatte pātubhūte

examples.text: piyappahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, maccherayuttā kalahā vivādā, vivādajātesu ca pesuṇāni.
vissajja ganthāni mun'īdha loke, vivādajātesu na vaggasārī, santo asantesu upekkhako so, anuggaho uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

69578.meaning1: source of quarrels; root of disputes; basis for contention

examples.text: cha'y'imāni, ānanda, vivādamūlāni. katamāni cha?

69580.meaning1: enters into arguments; gets into disputes
69580.commentary: (SNPa) vivādameti, diṭṭhiyaṃ ṭhatvā sayañ'ca satthārādīni minitvā so bhiyyo vivādametī'ti

examples.text: ete ca ñatvā upanissitā'ti, ñatvā munī nissaye so vimaṃsī, ñatvā vimutto na vivādam'eti, bhav'ābhavāya na sameti dhīro'ti.
vinicchaye ṭhatvā sayaṃ pamāya, uddhaṃ sa lokasmiṃ vivādam'eti, hitvāna sabbāni vinicchayāni, na medhagaṃ kubbati jantu loke'ti.
yā uṇṇatī s'āssa vighātabhūmi, mān'ātimānaṃ vadate pan'eso, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti.
yam'āhu saccaṃ tathiyan'ti eke, tam'āhu aññe tucchaṃ musā'ti, evam'pi vigayha vivādayanti, kasmā na ekaṃ samaṇā vadanti.

69583.meaning1: case involving dispute; issue regarding disagreement
69583.commentary: (VINa) tattha, idha bhikkhū vivadanti dhammo'ti vā adhammo'ti vā'ti evaṃ aṭṭhārasa bhedakaravatthūni nissāya uppanno vivādo vivād'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

examples.text: adhikaraṇaṃ nāma cattāri adhikaraṇāni, vivād'ādhikaraṇaṃ, anuvād'ādhikaraṇaṃ, āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ, kicc'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

69584.meaning1: fallen into dispute; engaged in arguing

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivād'āpannānaṃ viharataṃ bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ hoti bhāsitaparikkantaṃ.
bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivād'āpannānan'ti adhikaraṇajātānaṃ.
ye diṭṭhim'uggayha vivādiyanti, idam'eva saccan'ti ca vādayanti, te tvaṃ vadassū na hi te'dha atthi, vādamhi jāte paṭisenikattā.
ye kec'ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā, idam'eva saccan'ti vivādiyanti, sabb'eva te nindam'anvānayanti, atho pasaṃsam'pi labhanti tattha.

69587.meaning1: giving of a daughter in marriage

examples.text: disvāna keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca, kiṃ nu bhoto keṇiyassa āvāho vā bhavissati vivāho vā bhavissati mahāyañño vā paccupaṭṭhito, rājā vā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyenā'ti?

69588.notes: masc is prefereable to the neuter

69589.commentary: (DNa) vivāhanan'ti imaṃ dārikaṃ asukassa nāma dārakassa asukanakkhattena detha, evam'assā vuḍḍhi bhavissatī'ti vivāhakaraṇaṃ. (DNt) tathā dānaṃ vivāhanaṃ.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṃkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ
kassapo'pi, bhikkhave, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhati vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

69592.meaning1: is separate; is detached; is disengaged; is secluded (from)

examples.text: sabbāni vā etāni nibbānass'eva nāmāni. nibbānañ'hi patvā sattā sabbadukkhato nimuccanti pamuccanti viviccanti, tasmā tadeva nimokkho pamokkho viveko'ti vuttaṃ.

abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ pitu sakkassa kamm'ante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā.
vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

69594.commentary: (DNa) icchā vivicchā paraheṭhanā cā'ti taṇhālakkhaṇā icchā ca, macchariyalakkhaṇā vivicchā ca, vihiṃsālakkhaṇā paraheṭhanā ca.

examples.text: kodho mosavajjaṃ nikati ca dubbho, kadariyatā atimāno usūyā, icchā vivicchā paraheṭhanā ca, lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho, etesu yuttā anirāmagandhā, āpāyikā nivutabrahmalokāti.

69595.synonym: anissita, paṭilīna, patilīna, pavivitta, ritta, vippayutta, sallīna

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivittaṃ sen'āsanaṃ bhajati
patilīnacarassa bhikkhuno, bhajamānassa vivittam'āsanaṃ, sāmaggiyam'āhu tassa taṃ, yo attānaṃ bhavane na dassaye.

69598.meaning1: various kinds of; assorted; multiple; many types of

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ… vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ
muṭṭhīhi'pi yujjhanti, raṅgamajjhe'pi saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vadanti, idha, bhagini, naccassū'ti, nalāṭikam'pi denti, vividham'pi anācāraṃ ācaranti.

69599.notes: most likely a corruption of vivadha, from vi √vah

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena satta ca jaṭilā satta ca nigaṇṭhā satta ca acelakā satta ca ekasāṭakā satta ca paribbājakā parūḷhakacchanakhalomā khārivividham'ādāya bhagavato avidūre atikkamanti.
